summary_narrative:
Robert Alvarez holds a portfolio of approximately $500,000 across 5 holding(s), with 5% in cash. Stated risk tolerance: moderate. Overall risk posture is assessed as HIGH.

Key findings: Over-concentration in TSLA (high); Allocation drift in fixed_income (high); Allocation drift in equity (high).

This is the first review on record for this client.

Recommended next steps: Over-concentration in TSLA — Consider trimming and diversifying the position.; Allocation drift in fixed_income — Rebalance fixed_income toward its target weight.; Allocation drift in equity — Rebalance equity toward its target weight.

recommendations.title: Over-concentration in TSLA
recommendations.action: Consider trimming and diversifying the position.
recommendations.rationale: TSLA is 45% of total AUM, above the 25% single-holding limit. This exposes the client to idiosyncratic risk.

recommendations.title: Allocation drift in fixed_income
recommendations.action: Rebalance fixed_income toward its target weight.
recommendations.rationale: fixed_income is under-weight by 20% vs target (10% actual vs 30% target).

recommendations.title: Allocation drift in equity
recommendations.action: Rebalance equity toward its target weight.
recommendations.rationale: equity is over-weight by 25% vs target (85% actual vs 60% target).

recommendations.title: Large buy transaction (TSLA)
recommendations.rationale: A buy of 150,000 in TSLA on 2026-10-05 is 30% of AUM — an unusually large single move.

recommendations.title: Outlier transaction (ARKK)
recommendations.action: Review for error or unusual activity.
recommendations.rationale: A sell of 60,000 in ARKK on 2026-09-20 is a statistical outlier (modified z-score (MAD)) vs the client's typical transaction size.

recommendations.title: Possible duplicate buy (AAPL)
recommendations.action: Verify this is not a duplicate submission.
recommendations.rationale: Two buy transactions of 7,000 in AAPL occurred within 3 days — possible double entry.

recommendations.title: Complete KYC verification
recommendations.action: Follow up to complete KYC before acting on advice.
